title: Bursky Public Health earns accreditation
summary_en: Bursky Public Health met all 36 accreditation criteria while documenting a new institution still taking shape behind the scenes.

title: ‘Carolina Caycedo: Growing Deep Roots’
summary_en: The Kemper Art Museum at Washington University in St. Louis will present “Carolina Caycedo: Growing Deep Roots,” a solo exhibition of new and recent work by the Los Angeles–based Colombian artist Carolina Caycedo, Sept. 9 to Jan. 4.
